counter_increment_rules.unsealing_sessions: Increments from 0 to 1 immediately before the first read operation from the locked-test partition.
counter_increment_rules.evaluation_attempts: Increments immediately upon EVALUATION_RESERVED before model forward pass.
counter_increment_rules.completed_model_evaluations: Increments immediately after predictions are atomically renamed to predictions_seed_{seed}.json upon EVALUATION_COMPLETED.

fault_tolerance_policy.post_reservation_crash: Logs EVALUATION_ATTEMPT_INTERRUPTED in tamper-evident ledger; automatic retry strictly forbidden; human adjudication required.
fault_tolerance_policy.output_staging: Predictions written to .part file, flushed, fsynced, then atomically renamed via os.replace.
fault_tolerance_policy.post_inference_crash: Fail-closed; silent re-run is strictly forbidden once final predictions exist.

environmental_guards.network_isolation: Strictly passive verification (zero outbound socket probes, zero external transmissions; verifies proxies, routing tables, and container namespace metadata).
environmental_guards.read_only_data_mount: Strictly non-invasive verification (zero canary writes, zero filesystem mutations; verifies disjoint realpaths and mount ro flags).
